title: Page 10
content_zh:
“是呀，瞧我开心过了头，居然说出这么愚蠢的话。”他笑着紧紧抱住她。“不会再有下次了，绝对不会。”
梁昭颖回搂着他，笑容洋溢着甜美及幸福，在他的承诺下，她已经不会再担心及害怕，开心地等待两人即将圆满的结果。
一切都会否极泰来的，就在不久的将来……
梁昭颖要求退婚的事情早已闹得京城人尽皆知，当然楚婉也听说了。
虽然梁昭颖按照约定主动退婚，楚婉却从一开始就没有收手的打算，她还是打算将手中的图稿副本卖出去，得到一大笔银两后，连夜离开京城，到南方重新开始。
她小心翼翼地和好几个布庄的老板接洽，看他们想拿多少钱买图稿副本，最后吕记布庄的吕得泰出价最高，他愿意出一千两买下这份图稿，她便决定将图稿卖给他了。
他们俩约在城南一间偏僻荒废的庙宇内进行交易，免得被其它人见到他们俩有所往来，买卖一完成之后，楚婉便会直接离开京城，再也不会回来。
楚婉已经先一步到达约定的破庙里，没多久，吕得泰也进到庙内，两人的买卖正式开始。
“吕老板，我要先看到你所承诺的一千两。”
吕得泰非常爽快地拿出一张一千两银票。“这是无戚钱庄所开出的一千两银票，你到其它县城的钱庄分号都可以兑换出银两，这样你总该满意了吧？”
无戚钱庄在大的县城里都有设分号，并且信用非常良好，所以楚婉放心地收下。
她将图稿从包袱内拿出，还来不及交给吕得泰，好几个陌生男子即在这个时候冲了进来，将她和吕得泰隔开，并且抢走她手上的图稿，害她惊叫出声一一“你们这是在干什么？把图稿还给我！”
“楚婉，‘把图稿还给我’这句话应该是我说的才对。”另一抹天蓝色的身影也在这时走进荒废庙宇里。
“二……二公子？”楚婉瞬间脸色惨白，不敢相信他居然会在这最重要的节骨眼上出现。
属下将拿回的图稿交给戚无烟，戚无烟翻开来瞧了一眼，确定是百鸟朝凤图之后，就交由属下收起。
吕得泰愤怒地质问：“楚姑娘，现在到底是怎么一回事，戚无烟怎么会出现？”
“这……我……”她慌得不知道该如何回答才好，她也不知道戚无烟会在这个时候出现呀！
戚无烟神情冷淡地瞧向吕得泰。“你请回吧，这份图稿不可能卖给你的。”
“啧！”为免惹上不必要的麻烦，吕得泰只能赶紧离开。
戚无烟看着脸色惨白的楚婉，沈痛地说：“楚婉，我一直不想相信，我最信任的人居然会选择背叛我，但你……真是让我非常失望。”

她因为得不到他的爱而选择背叛他，甚至还想拿百鸟朝凤图稿牟利，原来他们多年来的合作情谊还不值那一千两。
楚婉双腿一软，颓丧地跪坐在地，既然事情已经败露，她也不必再多辩解些什么，就算后悔也已经来不及了。
“你……打算怎么处置我？”她眼眶含泪，绝望地问。
“无戚绣坊已经无法留你了，你可以去其它的绣坊发展，我不会让人将这件事情泄漏出去，从此之后，只盼你能够好自为之。”如果让其它人知道她曾经做出背叛雇主的行为，是不会有任何绣坊雇用她的，他念在旧情，放她一条生路，这已经是他最大的退让。
“呜……”知道戚无烟已经对她网开一面，楚婉既后悔又羞愧地痛哭出声，但就算她此刻对他忏悔，也已经来不及了。
如果她没有被嫉妒给蒙蔽了良心，她不会做出这样的事情，一步错，步步错，做过的错事永远不可能抹消，她也没有那个脸继续留在京城了。
幸好大错还没有酿成，事情没有走到最糟糕的地步，她会永远记取这个教训，绝对不再犯下难以弥补的过错了……
尾声戚、梁两家退婚的事本来闹得风风雨雨，大家都在等着梁家退婚，但没想到，之后梁家又不退了，看得大家一头雾水，不懂这两家到底在搞什么鬼。
两家不退婚，就没有好戏可以看，大家也渐渐把注意力转到其它的事情上头，风波很快地就平息下来。
至于楚婉也已默默地离开京城，到另外一个地方重新开始。
之后，无戚布庄呈上百鸟朝凤绣屏的日子到来了，从一早开始，就有一大群看热闹的百姓，挤在无戚布庄门前，想要一睹丰采。
林大人亲自带侍卫来收取无戚布庄的成品了，一辆大板车就停在布庄门口，准备运送制作好的绣屏，看热闹的众人更是不断地伸长脖子，希望有机会能够一睹绣屏的美丽。
戚无烟早已在布庄里恭候多时，他朝林大人躬身行礼，寒暄几句话之后，林大人就命令侍卫到布庄里将绣屏抬出来，过没多久，一扇约两人张开双手宽度的大屏风就出现在众人面前，总共由四名侍卫抬着，另外四名侍卫帮忙扶着，才能慢慢地抬出布庄，他们全小心翼翼地，就怕将屏风给碰坏了。
“哇……好大的屏风……”
“真可惜，居然用红布盖着，什么都看不到……”
大家惋惜声不断，没想到连绣屏的一小角都看不到，结果在侍卫们合力将屏风给推上板车的那一瞬间，红布出人意料地滑落下来，一副绝美绝艳的华丽绣屏便呈现在众人面前，让在场的所有人都忍不住赞叹不已。
“真是美……太美了……”
“果然不愧是无戚布庄，我从没见过如此华丽的绣屏，简直是百年难得一见的杰作呀！”
屏风上绣着数不清的各色鸟类，形状都不同，姿态也不一样，各有各的特色，还活灵活现的，牠们围绕着站在高枝上的美丽大凤凰，就像是在向凤凰朝拜一样，整个屏风呈现出一种非常大气的华丽风格，让人惊艳不已。
林大人一见红布意外地滑落，在侍卫们将屏风顺利抬上板车之后，赶紧命令：“快把红布捡起来，重新覆盖上去。”

“是的，大人。”
梁昭颖此刻也在布庄里，听到外头百姓们赞叹的声音，她的嘴角大大勾起，感到与有荣焉。
事情终于结束了，他们也可以好好松下一口气，能制作送给皇太后的贺寿绣屏，虽然非常荣幸，但所需承受的压力也不小，而那些压力在听到百姓的赞叹声之后，瞬间全消散了，因为他们相信，皇太后一定也会非常喜欢的。
戚无烟送走林大人之后，就走回布庄里，其它的琐碎小事就交由吴掌柜去打理了。
梁昭颖漾起开心的笑。“恭喜你喽，往后无戚布庄的生意肯定蒸蒸日上，钱财滚滚来。”
“谢谢。”戚无烟也开怀地笑了。“其实你有一半的功劳，我有一样东西想给你。”
“什么东西？”
“等你瞧见就明白了。”他故意卖起关子，吊她胃口。
戚无烟将梁昭颖带到绣坊里放置成品的小房间里，房内中间的衣架被盖上一层红布，好保护在红布底下的东西。
他牵着她来到衣架前，扬起神秘的笑。“自己
他到底在卖什么关子？梁昭颖好奇极了，立刻将红布掀开，看看里头放的究竟是什么。
掀开红布，一套已经制作完成的嫁衣披搭在衣架上，那艳红色的布料泛着丝缎般的光泽，一看就知所用的料子非常上等。
content_en:
"Yeah, look, I was too happy to say such stupid things." He smiled and hugged her tightly. "There won't be a next time, absolutely not."
Liang Zhaoying hugged him back, her smile filled with sweetness and happiness. With his promise, she no longer worried and feared, and happily waited for the consummation of the two of them.
Will everything be fine in the near future...
Liang Zhaoying's request to break off the engagement has long been known to everyone in the capital, and of course Chu Wan also heard about it.
Although Liang Zhaoying took the initiative to break off the engagement as agreed, Chu Wan had no intention of stopping from the beginning. She still planned to sell the copy of the artwork in her hand. After getting a large sum of money, she left the capital overnight and started over in the south.
She carefully contacted several cloth shop owners to see how much they wanted to pay for copies of the artwork. In the end, Lu Detai from Luji Cloth Shop offered the highest bid. He was willing to pay one thousand taels for the artwork, so she decided to sell the artwork to him.
The two of them agreed to conduct a transaction in a remote and abandoned temple in the south of the city, so as not to be seen by others interacting with each other. Once the transaction was completed, Chu Wan would leave the capital directly and never come back.
Chu Wan had already arrived at the ruined temple as agreed. Not long after, Lu Detai also entered the temple, and the business between the two officially began.
"Boss Lu, I want to see the thousand taels you promised first."
Lu Detai readily took out a thousand taels of silver note. "This is a thousand taels of silver note issued by Wuqi Bank. You can exchange it for silver taels at bank branches in other counties. You should be satisfied, right?"
Wuqi Bank has branches in major counties and has very good credit, so Chu Wan accepted it with confidence.
She took the artwork out of the bag and before she could give it to Lu Detai, several strange men rushed in at this moment, separated her from Lu Detai, and snatched the artwork from her hand, causing her to scream in surprise - "What are you doing? Give me the artwork back!"
"Chu Wan, I should be the one who said 'return the drawing to me'." Another sky-blue figure also walked into the abandoned temple at this time.
"Second...Second Young Master?" Chu Wan turned pale instantly, unable to believe that he would appear at this most important moment.
The subordinate handed the drawing back to Qi Wuyan. Qi Wuyan opened it and took a look. After confirming that it was a picture of hundreds of birds facing the phoenix, he handed it over to his subordinate to put it away.
Lu Detai asked angrily: "Miss Chu, what is going on now? Why did Qi Wuyan show up?"
"This...I..." She was so panicked that she didn't know how to answer. She didn't know that Qi Wuyan would appear at this time!
Qi Wuyan looked at Lu Detai with a cold expression. "Please take it back. I can't sell this manuscript to you."
"Tsk!" In order to avoid getting into unnecessary trouble, Lu Detai could only leave quickly.
Qi Wuyan looked at the pale Chu Wan and said sadly: "Chu Wan, I never wanted to believe that the person I trusted the most would actually choose to betray me, but you... really disappointed me."
She chose to betray him because she couldn't get his love, and even wanted to profit from the drawing of Birds Chao Phoenix. It turned out that their cooperative friendship over the years was not worth the thousand taels.
Chu Wan's legs went weak and she knelt down on the ground dejectedly. Now that the matter had been revealed, she didn't need to make any more excuses. Even if she regretted it, it was already too late.
"What...are you going to do with me?" She asked desperately with tears in her eyes.
"Wuqi Embroidery Workshop can't keep you anymore. You can go to other embroidery workshops to develop. I won't let anyone leak this matter. From now on, I only hope that you can behave yourself." If others knew that she had betrayed her employer, no embroidery workshop would hire her. He missed his old friendship and let her live. This was his biggest concession.
"Ugh..." Knowing that Qi Wuyan had already opened up on herOn the one hand, Chu Wan cried out with regret and shame, but even if she confessed to him at this moment, it was already too late.
If she hadn't been blinded by jealousy, she wouldn't have done such a thing. She made one mistake every step of the way. The wrong things she had done could never be erased, and she wouldn't have the face to stay in the capital.
Fortunately, a big mistake has not yet been made, and things have not reached the worst point. She will always remember this lesson and will never make irreparable mistakes again...
At the end, the Qi and Liang families broke off their engagement. Everyone was waiting for the Liang family to break off their engagement, but unexpectedly, the Liang family stopped their engagement again. Everyone was confused and didn't understand what the hell these two families were doing.
If the two families did not cancel the engagement, there would be no good show to watch. Everyone gradually turned their attention to other things, and the turmoil quickly subsided.
As for Chu Wan, she has quietly left the capital and started over in another place.
Later, the day came when Wuqi Buzhuang presented the phoenix embroidered screen with hundreds of birds facing the sky. From early in the morning, there was a large group of people watching the excitement, crowding in front of Wuqi Buzhuang, wanting to have a glimpse of the splendor.
Mr. Lin personally brought his guards to collect the finished products from Wuqi Cloth Factory. A large truck was parked at the entrance of Wuqi Cloth Factory, ready to transport the finished embroidered screens. The people watching the excitement stretched their necks, hoping to have a chance to see the beauty of the embroidered screens.
Qi Wuyan had been waiting in the cloth shop for a long time. He bowed and saluted Mr. Lin. After exchanging a few words, Mr. Lin ordered the guards to carry the embroidered screen out of the cloth shop. Not long after, a large screen about the width of two people's hands appeared in front of everyone. It was carried by four guards in total, and the other four guards helped to support it before it could be slowly carried out of the cloth shop. They were all careful, fearing that the screen would be damaged.
"Wow...what a big screen..."
"It's such a pity that it's covered with red cloth and you can't see anything..."
Everyone kept lamenting, but they didn't expect that even a small corner of the embroidered screen could not be seen. As a result, the moment the guards worked together to push the screen onto the cart, the red cloth unexpectedly slipped down, and a beautiful and gorgeous embroidered screen appeared in front of everyone, making everyone present couldn't help but admire it.
"It's so beautiful...so beautiful..."
"As expected of Wuqi Cloth Shop, I have never seen such a gorgeous embroidered screen. It is a masterpiece that is rare to see in a century!"
The screen is embroidered with countless birds of various colors, all with different shapes and postures. Each has its own characteristics and is vivid. They surround the beautiful phoenix standing on a high branch, as if they are worshiping the phoenix. The entire screen presents a very grand and gorgeous style, which is amazing.
When Master Lin saw the red cloth accidentally slipping down, after the guards successfully carried the screen onto the cart, he quickly ordered: "Quickly pick up the red cloth and cover it again."
"Yes, my lord."
Liang Zhaoying was also in the cloth village at the moment. When she heard the voices of admiration from the people outside, the corners of her mouth curled up and she felt so honored.
The matter is finally over, and they can breathe a sigh of relief. Although it is a great honor to be able to make the embroidered screen for the birthday of the Empress Dowager, it also requires a lot of pressure. After hearing the praises of the people, all the pressure disappeared in an instant, because they believed that the Empress Dowager would also like it very much.
After Qi Wuyan saw off Master Lin, he walked back to the cloth shop, leaving other trivial matters to Shopkeeper Wu to take care of.
Liang Zhaoying smiled happily. "Congratulations. Wuqi Cloth Village's business will definitely be booming in the future, and the money will roll in."
"Thank you." Qi Wuyan also smiled happily. "Actually, you have half of the credit. I have something I want to give you."
"What?"
"You'll understand when you see it." He deliberately played it off to seduce her.
Qi Wuyan took Liang Zhaoying to the embroidery workshop and placed herIn the small room of the store, the clothes hanger in the middle of the room was covered with a layer of red cloth to protect the things under the red cloth.
He led her to the clothes rack and smiled mysteriously. "Myself
What on earth is he selling? Liang Zhaoying was so curious that she immediately opened the red cloth to see what was inside.
Opening up the red cloth, a set of completed wedding dresses was draped on the hanger. The bright red cloth had a satin-like luster, and you could tell at a glance that the material used was of very high quality.
